script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title: SPECTRUM SHIFT

INT. STUDIO APARTMENT - DAY

JESSICA, a successful graphic designer, sits on her couch, staring at a blank computer screen. She's lost in thought, her fingers tapping out a nervous rhythm.

JESSICA
(to herself)
I can't keep doing this...

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jessica meets with her best friend, LUCY, a former graphic designer turned art therapist.

LUCY
(concerned)
You look drained. What's going on?

JESSICA
I'm just... tired. I feel like I've hit a wall.

LUCY
What's new at work?

JESSICA
The same old thing. Deadlines, meetings, revisions... I've lost touch with why I fell in love with design in the first place.

Lucy places a comforting hand on Jessica's shoulder.

LUCY
You deserve more than this. Have you considered a career change?

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Jessica explores an art gallery, mesmerized by the vibrant colors and textures. She bumps into MAX, a charismatic painter, who strikes up a conversation.

MAX
(smiling)
Is that your first time at an art gallery?

JESSICA
(surprised)
Yes. I've always loved art, but I never thought about pursuing a career in it.

MAX
You could always try painting. It's a different kind of challenge, but very rewarding.

INT. STUDIO APARTMENT - DAY

Jessica sets up a makeshift art studio in her living room. She experiments with colors and textures, painting with abandon.

JESSICA
(to herself)
This feels right...

INT. ART SCHOOL - DAY

Jessica enrolls in an art school, feeling a renewed sense of purpose. She meets fellow students, including NICO, a talented sculptor.

NICO
(encouraging)
You have a natural talent for this. Don't let fear hold you back.

INT. ART SCHOOL - LATER

Jessica presents her first painting to the class. They are in awe of her talent.

PROFESSOR
(impressed)
You have a unique perspective, Jessica. I see great things in your future.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jessica tells Lucy about her art school experience and her newfound passion. Lucy beams with pride.

LUCY
I'm so happy for you. You've finally found your spark again.

INT. ART EXHIBIT - NIGHT

Jessica's artwork is featured in a local art exhibit. Max is there to support her, and they share a passionate kiss.

MAX
(smiling)
I'm proud of you, Jessica.

INT. STUDIO APARTMENT - DAY

Jessica continues to paint, her face filled with joy and determination. She has made the spectum shift from a successful graphic designer to a passionate artist.

THE END
